name: JPG to PNG
summary: Convert JPG / JPEG images to PNG in your browser — no upload required.
description: Drop a JPEG photo, preview the PNG result, and download a .png file. Conversion uses the Canvas API on your device so the image never leaves your machine.

faqs.question: Will the PNG be larger?
faqs.answer: Often yes. JPEG is lossy and compact; PNG is lossless, so file size usually grows.

faqs.question: Is my photo uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I convert PNG to JPG?
faqs.answer: Yes — use the PNG to JPG tool.
